correctness.rationale: Directly inspected pinned RESULT.md. Kummer/Legendre give X=sum outgoing carries and Y=sum(digit-outgoing carry), so X+Y=s_3(n). The displayed two-state transition M=[[1+v,uv],[1,u(1+v)]] has the claimed trace and determinant; Cayley–Hamilton yields numerator 1-uz, exact recurrence and support by constructive digit strings. Carry Markov covariance calculation gives the moments, and dominant eigenvalue expansion at (u,v)=(1,1) has Hessian diagonal (1/2,1/6), proving the joint CLT. Independent direct integer-frequency and rational moment enumeration to r=6 matched; no finite enumeration alone proves all r.
